items.description: Deploy autonomous AI agents in your browser.

items.title: Tongyi WebAgent
items.description: WebAgent for information seeking built by Tongyi Lab, Alibaba Group.

items.title: Openwork
items.description: An MIT-licensed, open alternative to Anthropic's Cowork built with Opencode and dev-browser. Supports multiple LLM providers for launching computer-use agents to automate browser workflows.

items.title: Agent-E
items.description: Agent & framework with HTML DOM distillation.

items.title: WebVoyager (Agent)
items.description: Vision-enabled web agent.

items.title: Autonomous Web Agents
OpenInterpreter
items.description: An open-source CLI based agent that can write & execute code as well as control your browser.

items.title: UI-TARS
items.description: A GUI agent model designed to interact seamlessly with GUIs using human-like perception, reasoning, and action capabilities.

items.title: Self-Operating Computer Framework
items.description: A framework to enable multimodal models to operate a computer.
Tools, frameworks and libraries that translate natural language instructions into web interactions.

items.title: VimGPT
items.description: Experimental project using GPT-4 Vision to browse the web via the Vimium extension.

items.title: agent-qa
items.description: Self-improving QA harness for natural-language web test runs with execution memory and self-healing actions.

items.title: PulsarRPA
items.description: AI-powered browser automation for data extraction.

items.title: AI Web Automation Tools
AutoGPT
items.description: Experimental agent for task completion and web browsing.

items.title: Bytebot
items.description: Containerized computer use agent framework with a virtual desktop environment.

items.title: Webwright
items.description: Browser agent framework from Microsoft Research where the agent writes and runs Playwright scripts in a terminal workspace; supports OpenAI, Anthropic, and OpenRouter backends.

items.title: BrowserAct
items.description: Browser automation CLI and skills for AI agents to operate real browsers, manage sessions, support human handoff, and capture screenshots and evidence.

items.title: invisible-playwright
items.description: Playwright wrapper for a stealth-patched Firefox 150 build. Drop-in replacement returning native Playwright Browser objects; spoofing happens in C++ source with no JS-level overrides.

items.title: Tarsier
items.description: Vision utilities library for web interaction agents.

items.title: HUD
items.description: Open-source SDK for building browser and computer-use RL environments to evaluate and train web agents, with task-based verifiable rewards runnable as evals or RL training across any model.

items.title: Lumen
items.description: Vision-first browser agent with self-healing deterministic replay. Screenshot → model → action loop over CDP, multi-provider (Anthropic, Google, OpenAI), action caching for zero-token reruns.

items.title: Agent Browser Shield
items.description: Browser extension that sits between an AI agent and the page, stripping prompt injection, masking PII/credentials, and removing dark patterns before content reaches the model.

items.title: Atlas
items.description: Open-source deep research harness for building cited web research agents with ledger-based coverage audits, pluggable search providers, and Steel-backed browser fetches.

items.title: BrowserTrace
items.description: Local-first trace viewer for debugging Playwright, Browser Use, Stagehand, and other web-agent runs with redacted shareable exports.
Web crawlers & scrapers that leverage AI to navigate websites and extract content.

items.title: LLM Scraper
items.description: Uses LLMs for intelligent scraping and content understanding.

items.title: WebAgent (OpenAgents)
items.description: The web-browsing agent module of the OpenAgents platform (HKU). Enables autonomous navigation of websites via natural language, as part of a larger multi-modal agent framework.

items.title: SpiderCreator
items.description: Create complex Playwright spiders with natural language prompts.

items.title: Plasmate
items.description: Open-source headless browser engine for AI agents. Compiles HTML to Semantic Object Model (SOM) with 17.5x token compression. 13 MCP tools. First browser tool on the MCP Registry. Rust, Apache-2.0.

items.title: AI Web Scrapers/Crawlers

items.description: Datasets, benchmarks, and notable research efforts for evaluating and advancing web-capable AI agents.

items.title: Bananalyzer
items.description: An open-source evaluation framework for web-based AI agents.

items.title: WebCanvas
items.description: An online evaluation framework for dynamic web environments. Tests agents on live websites.

items.title: WebTaskBench
items.description: 51-URL benchmark comparing HTML vs Markdown vs SOM representations for AI agents. Measures token efficiency, latency, and accuracy across GPT-4o and Claude Sonnet 4.
